answer: Sybil resistance comes from coupling EigenTrust-style centrality to reputation with an exponential temporal half-life: influence fades unless peers sustain honest service over time. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity limits the value of collusive endorsements, while freshly spawned identities—whether labeled copper, saffron, or sable—begin with near-zero eigenvector centrality and lack trusted paths, so they cannot meet consensus thresholds without earning durable, independently supported trust.
